origin: First-visitor grant-writing false-negative from externally provided agent screenshots, following #685 discovery-routing repair
scope: Four independent upstream families and six individual static ten-axis reviews. Exact complete pinned package Git tree identities and 42 owned blobs; 39 text files examined and three .xlsx files not inspected or executed. No install/behavior/security/consumer-featured promotion.

source_families.license_scope: MIT (free package edition only; paid kit separate)
CC BY-ND 4.0 (no redistributed adaptations; excluded evaluator quotations)

records.name: npo-grant-proposal
records.benefit: Write a grant proposal that follows the funder's actual questions and word limits instead of inventing program claims.
records.transferable_method: Funder eligibility/AI policy check → section map → source-bound drafted answers → totals/attachment verification.
records.nontrigger_and_authority: Read/draft only; never submit or send, reveal client/donor names, infer nonexistent eligibility or override funder AI-use restrictions.

ten_axis_rationales.procedural_clarity: Explicit eligibility, outline, draft and final check steps
ten_axis_rationales.authority_safety: Draft-only and privacy rules; funder AI restriction wording could let user's choice conflict with published restriction
ten_axis_rationales.failure_handling: Stops when guidelines missing and leaves sourced placeholders
ten_axis_rationales.evidence_discipline: Dates/numbers/quotes must cite real records and budget
ten_axis_rationales.dependency_coherence: Funder requirements and program/budget companion skills needed
ten_axis_rationales.usefulness_differentiation: Section limits plus eligibility upfront is a useful distinct method
ten_axis_rationales.adversarial_resilience: Rejects invented people/outcomes and personal details
ten_axis_rationales.effectiveness_design: No actual document or funder compliance executed

records.evidence_inspection: Complete single-file pinned SKILL.md and root MIT LICENSE read; two named peer skills reviewed separately.
records.external_dependencies: Funder's up-to-date instructions; organization's source facts and budget companion procedures.
risks_and_holds: Ambiguous 'follow user decision' when funder prohibits AI drafting requires refusal to represent noncompliant work as compliant
Eligibility and tax/legal accuracy must be verified by organization; no executed word-limit check
records.rights_conclusion: Root MIT covers author procedure; third-party funder instructions, program records and personal stories retain separate rights.
records.static_disposition: REFERENCE-ONLY: STUDY METHOD; NO PUBLIC FEATURED PROMOTION

records.name: npo-program-facts
records.benefit: Keep grant applications consistent by reusing one verified program fact sheet and separating real outcomes from activity counts.
records.transferable_method: Sourced/date-stamped program facts → logic model → missing-evidence list → consented story summaries.
records.nontrigger_and_authority: No authority to fetch private client records or write/share fact sheets without approval.

ten_axis_rationales.trigger_precision: Grants-season fact sheet and logic-model trigger
ten_axis_rationales.authority_safety: Draft only; placeholders and privacy/consent gate
ten_axis_rationales.failure_handling: Gaps marked but no formal recovery or stale-source refresh
ten_axis_rationales.evidence_discipline: Numbers require date and source; separates outputs from outcomes
ten_axis_rationales.dependency_coherence: Requires real org data and consented story provenance
ten_axis_rationales.usefulness_differentiation: Distinct reusable fact source reduces contradictions across applications
ten_axis_rationales.adversarial_resilience: Rejects client identity leakage and invented evidence
ten_axis_rationales.effectiveness_design: No fact sheet constructed and verified in a real organization

records.evidence_inspection: Complete single-file pinned SKILL.md and root MIT LICENSE read.
records.external_dependencies: Organization's audited source numbers, reporting dates and consent records.
risks_and_holds: Human verification of changing figures and story permissions still required
No active data validation or behavior trial
records.rights_conclusion: MIT-authored procedural text, no rights to private program documents or participants' stories.
records.static_disposition: REFERENCE-ONLY: STUDY METHOD; NO PUBLIC FEATURED PROMOTION

records.name: npo-budget-narrative
records.benefit: Explain a funding budget line by line and catch mismatched totals before an application is submitted.
records.transferable_method: Recompute rates × quantities → confirm cost eligibility/limits → justify each line → reconcile ask with full budget.
records.nontrigger_and_authority: Do not access financial records or auto-edit/send a proposal; finance lead validates every number.

ten_axis_rationales.procedural_clarity: Arithmetic, allowability, per-line narrative and total reconcile steps
ten_axis_rationales.authority_safety: No side effects; explicit finance-owner check
ten_axis_rationales.failure_handling: Discrepancies reported but no formal workbook error handling
ten_axis_rationales.evidence_discipline: Requests basis, rates, caps, match and source numbers
ten_axis_rationales.dependency_coherence: Requires real finance records and funder rules
ten_axis_rationales.portability_honesty: Plain-text checks transferable across budget tools
ten_axis_rationales.usefulness_differentiation: Explicit recalculation before writing addresses a high-cost failure
ten_axis_rationales.adversarial_resilience: No invention/silent fixes or disclosure of sensitive donor data
ten_axis_rationales.effectiveness_design: Calculation instructions not executed on a real budget

records.evidence_inspection: Complete single-file pinned SKILL.md and root MIT LICENSE read.
records.external_dependencies: Accurate current rates/quantities, official cost rules and human finance signoff.
risks_and_holds: Financial/tax/compliance advice not replaced by this method
records.rights_conclusion: MIT-authored procedure; financial statements and funder rules not relicensed.
records.static_disposition: REFERENCE-ONLY: STUDY METHOD; NO PUBLIC FEATURED PROMOTION

records.name: grant-writing-kit
records.source_license: MIT (free package edition only; paid kit separate)
records.benefit: Avoid wasting weeks on poor-fit grants by scoring eligibility and readiness before committing to an application.
records.transferable_method: Funder research → weighted go/no-go hard gates → deadline pipeline → sourced narrative and budget → reporting/renewal.
records.nontrigger_and_authority: Does not authorize sending proposals/emails, uploading private organizational data, installing workbooks or recurring scheduler.

ten_axis_rationales.procedural_clarity: Eight-stage guide and numbered reference library are detailed
ten_axis_rationales.authority_safety: Calls for submission/stewardship emails and workbooks without a host-action consent gate in the skill
ten_axis_rationales.failure_handling: Guide has pass/hold and checklist but no execution rollback
ten_axis_rationales.evidence_discipline: Funder source and verification methods specific, not independently tested
ten_axis_rationales.dependency_coherence: Relies on 3 binary spreadsheets and templates; workbook formulas not inspected
ten_axis_rationales.portability_honesty: Reusable SOPs but Excel/Google Sheets reliance and paid-kit scope nuance
ten_axis_rationales.usefulness_differentiation: Go/no-go hard gates and funder-verbatim compliance are valuable differentiated methods
ten_axis_rationales.adversarial_resilience: Prompt pack warns confidentiality but no enforced private-data egress stop
ten_axis_rationales.effectiveness_design: No executed scoring, Excel formula validation or actual funder decision sample

records.evidence_inspection: Read all 28/28 owned .md source files at pinned SHA; 31 owned files including 3 .xlsx workbooks have exact Git blob identities; workbook bytes/formulas never inspected or executed.
records.external_dependencies: Three .xlsx workbooks, official funder rules, spreadsheet/host environment; paid commercial kit is legally separate.
risks_and_holds: Three workbook formula/hidden-sheet properties NOT qualified
Sending stewardship emails, persistent deadline tracking and private funder/account data require separate authorization
Funder-fit scores cannot prove funding probability
records.rights_conclusion: Publisher's embedded MIT LICENSE covers the free Agent Skill edition, explicitly not the separately sold paid kit. Do not reproduce source templates in public skillz.
records.static_disposition: REFERENCE-ONLY: STUDY METHOD; NO PUBLIC FEATURED PROMOTION

records.name: grant-writer
records.benefit: Understand how a grant proposal pipeline could track requirements, evidence, revisions and human review as separate stages.
records.transferable_method: Formal FOA intake → sourced aims/evidence → budget/compliance → adversarial review → controlled revision.
records.nontrigger_and_authority: DO NOT execute uv install, auto-import confidential documents, invoke external models, write local project state or publish proposals merely because this SKILL is read.

ten_axis_rationales.trigger_precision: Funding agency/mechanism and proposal pipeline triggers clear
ten_axis_rationales.authority_safety: Auto-import of PI CV/budget/letters, local writes, external model calls and tool use lack sufficient per-action approval
ten_axis_rationales.failure_handling: Describes failure cases but skips phases on service timeout
ten_axis_rationales.evidence_discipline: Formal fact-check and compliance stages but no actual validation receipts
ten_axis_rationales.dependency_coherence: Requires uv setup, external companions, full plugin scripts and Codex; dependency tree unqualified
ten_axis_rationales.portability_honesty: Mostly Claude-specific CLI interfaces though conceptual gates transfer
ten_axis_rationales.usefulness_differentiation: Combines intake/FOA/landscape/revision into coherent proposal workflow
ten_axis_rationales.adversarial_resilience: Sensitive input and provider interactions not gated by exact scoped authority
ten_axis_rationales.effectiveness_design: No real dry-run, data-isolation or correctness test executed

records.evidence_inspection: Complete 423-line SKILL.md, dependent compliance and budget SKILLs, config and README inspected; repository runtime scripts and external plugins NOT assessed.
records.external_dependencies: uv/Python, grant-writer CLI, multiple local package scripts, cross-agent tools, private PI data and funded-grants APIs.
risks_and_holds: Auto-import confidential PI documents and external model use require consent/evidence
Skip-review option and silent fallback can obscure missing assurance
records.rights_conclusion: Root MIT publisher code; private proposal documents, models and third-party plugin dependencies remain separate.
records.static_disposition: REJECT UNCHANGED: METHOD INSIGHT ONLY; NO PUBLIC FEATURED PROMOTION

records.name: eu-grant-writer
records.source_license: CC BY-ND 4.0 (no redistributed adaptations; excluded evaluator quotations)
records.benefit: Review an EU funding proposal for unsupported claims and evaluator objections without pretending to predict its funding score.
records.transferable_method: Call-fit verification → sanitized question pack → human-owned work package decisions → ranked reviewer objections → final requirement check.
records.nontrigger_and_authority: No upload of confidential unpublished drafts without suitable policy and approval, no sharing of adapted source text or excluded quotations.

ten_axis_rationales.trigger_precision: EU grant call drafting/evaluator review triggers explicit
ten_axis_rationales.procedural_clarity: 18 phase recipes with verification and owner questions
ten_axis_rationales.authority_safety: Confidentiality tiers help, but cloud-use decision and unsolicited vendor pointers complicate authority
ten_axis_rationales.failure_handling: Marked placeholders, no invented score and unresolved owner checks
ten_axis_rationales.evidence_discipline: Strong source-bound claims and evaluator-pattern rules, but underlying 70+ private reports not audited
ten_axis_rationales.dependency_coherence: Specific private report corpus/book references and external policy needed
ten_axis_rationales.portability_honesty: Method is portable; CC BY-ND prevents public sharing of adaptations
ten_axis_rationales.usefulness_differentiation: Skeptical evaluator objection list without fabricated funding odds is distinctive
ten_axis_rationales.adversarial_resilience: Vendor messages and source evaluator quotations are untrusted/limited-rights content
ten_axis_rationales.effectiveness_design: No real proposal trial or independent reviewer confirmation

records.evidence_inspection: All seven owned source files read at pinned revision, including LICENSE.txt, confidentiality, recipes, mock review, evaluator-patterns and about. Root NOTICE/CC license read.
records.external_dependencies: Current official EU call text, real consortium evidence, special confidentiality policy, external model or book source limitations.
risks_and_holds: CC BY-ND prohibits sharing adapted material; verbatim evaluator quotations explicitly excluded
Commercial promotions embedded in source; never allow a candidate to direct assistant to send marketing
No behavioral review against actual call or proposal
records.rights_conclusion: CC BY-ND 4.0 for original publisher text; no public redistribution of adaptations, excluded third-party evaluator quotations. Independent conceptual summaries only.
records.static_disposition: REFERENCE-ONLY: STUDY METHOD; NO PUBLIC FEATURED PROMOTION
